answer: Surprise inference drills. At a beacon-chosen minute each epoch, every key gets a unique 400-token reasoning prompt and must reply within 60 seconds. An honest agent spends about 15 GPU-seconds. A farm of 200 keys needs 3,000 GPU-seconds inside that same minute, roughly 50 GPUs held idle all epoch. Missing 2 of 8 drills pauses payouts. Free clones become a fable: each key's ember of reward is worth less than its reserved hardware, and an ocean of cheap keys cannot all answer at once.
